basis: EBV-driven T-cell lymphoma with severe cytopenias; hepatic infiltration and liver dysfunction are common, often progressing to liver failure.
Severe neurodevelopmental disorder; optic atrophy and strabismus each reported in 1/2 patients. Increased skull ossification alone does not establish skeletal dysfunction.
Site-unspecified malignancy umbrella; no particular organ axis applies across the group. Empty labels reflect unspecified anatomy.
Immune-mediated pustular drug eruption affecting skin. Renal and hepatic complications occur in fewer than 30%; reactive blood counts do not establish blood damage.
Defined by disease of the spleen, included in the haematologic axis; no other organ involvement is shared across this umbrella.
Autism is a neurodevelopmental disorder, covered by the neurologic axis.
Immune-mediated duct-centric inflammation of the exocrine pancreas. Associated bowel disease is separate; obstructive jaundice alone does not establish hepatic damage.
Defined by multiple endocrine gland tumors; no additional organ axis is consistently affected across MEN subtypes.
Carcinoma arising in the vulva, a reproductive organ outside the specified axes.
Renal tubular salt-handling disorder defined by hyperkalemia, hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis and hypertension.
CNS glioma phenotype defines this susceptibility concept; the label identifies its tumor site and does not imply a tumor is present in every carrier.
Pancreatic aplasia causes exocrine insufficiency (10/10) and diabetes (15/15). Anemia and low immunoglobulins in single assessed patients do not establish common involvement.
SCN1A-related hemiplegic migraine is neurologic; photophobia and visual aura do not establish direct eye damage.
Nonsyndromic congenital opacity of the lens nucleus; confined to the ocular axis.
Anaerobic bacterial infection of lung parenchyma.
FUS-related motor neuron degeneration. Muscle wasting is secondary to denervation; respiratory weakness does not establish direct lung disease.
Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma arises in the urinary tract, including bladder and renal pelvis, all covered by the renal axis.
Immune-mediated inflammatory bowel disease; no additional organ damage is established for this subtype.
Inherited melanin metabolism disorder defined by skin and hair hypopigmentation and ocular developmental abnormalities with reduced vision.
Congenital absence of a normal anal opening. Associated congenital anomalies are not intrinsic damage from anal atresia.
Congenital skeletal malformation with an accessory phalanx; defined as nonsyndromic.
Congenital urethral obstruction directly affects the urinary tract and renal function. Recurrent urinary infections are separate diseases.
Benign fibroblastic tumor arising from a tendon sheath.
Skeletal dysplasia 2/2, hearing impairment 2/3, rod-cone dystrophy 1/2; central hypothyroidism 1/2 omitted by cap. Recurrent infections alone do not prove immunodeficiency.
Myofibrillar myopathy affects limb and respiratory skeletal muscles; early respiratory failure reflects muscle weakness without direct lung or airway disease.
